def-parametrized-morse-trajectory-space: consumed at Definition/Statement/Remark: Let $(f,X)$ be a Morse--Smale pair on a closed manifold $M$ ([[def-morse-smale-pair]]) and let $p,q$ be critical points. The set of all broken trajectories from $p$ to $q$ is written $\overline{\mathcal M}(p,q)$; a broken trajectory of length $r=1$ is an ordinary trajectory, so $\mathcal M(p,q)\subseteq\overline{\mathcal M}(p,q)$ under the orbit-set identification ([[def-unparametrized-morse-trajectory-moduli-space]]), and a broken trajectory of length $r=2$ is called **once-broken**. The components are nonconstant, the intermediate points strictly decrease in value and in index, and $r\le\lambda(p)-\lambda(q)$, by [[lem-broken-morse-trajectories-have-strictly-decreasing-critical-values-and-indices]]; in particular $p_i\ne p_{i+1}$ is automatic, and $\overline{\mathcal M}(p,q)=\mathcal M(p,q)$ whenever $\lambda(p)-\lambda(q)=1$.
